title: apium graveolens f. lusitanicum
intro: Apium graveolens f. lusitanicum, commonly known as Lusitanian celery, is a subspecies of wild celery that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Lusitanian celery include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and carminative properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as polyacetylenes, flavonoids, and volatile oils. The bioactive constituents of Lusitanian celery have been found to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic effects.
